messages:
marie: Heads up — scheduling a rack power transition for rck-12 in eu-west2 to replace a flaky PDU. Window: Tue 2026-05-05 02:00-04:00 UTC. We'll cordon nodes and do rolling reboots. Estimated capacity loss ~22% in the GPU pool during the window. Details below.

alex: Ack. Which pools are impacted? Any canaries?

srijan: Affected: pool-gpu-eu-west2-primary (64 nodes across 8 racks). We'll hit rck-12 first (8 nodes). Canary: 1 node will be rebooted and smoke-tested for 15m before we proceed.

marie: Plan: cordon rck-12 nodes -> drain -> reboot -> healthcheck -> uncordon. Stagger 2 nodes at a time, 10m gap between cohorts. If queue latency median >2m for 3 consecutive cohorts -> abort and fallback to us-east overflow route.

marie: Drain command we'll use:```kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=120```followed by a short reboot and `kubectl uncordon`.

kai: How about prewarming caches? Can we reduce tail by warming prefix and KV caches before the window?

emily: Yes — we can prewarm from the warm pool. Proposal: +10 spot-backfill nodes in eu-west2 starting 30m before the window. Cost estimate: spot delta ~ $160/hr -> ~ $320 for the 2h window incl warmup. Cross-region fallback (if we need to shift ~20% traffic to us-east) could add ~ $800 in egress charges.

pat: Oncall note: @oncall-bot I'll own the runbook during the window and monitor queues + GPU metrics. Will add a deploy-blocker tag if we need to stop.

oncall-bot: assigned: infra-ops duty to pat. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pdu-reboot (check checklist sections 1-4).

srijan: Suggest evicting low-priority batch jobs ahead of time (bump QoS eviction for batch to prefer preemptible). That reduces pressure during cohorts.

marie: Good call — I'll add `priorityClass` overrides and TTLs to the maintenance playbook. Rolling schedule in the playbook: rck-12 cohort A (nodes 1-2) 02:00-02:20, cohort B 02:30-02:50, cohort C 03:00-03:20, final checks 03:20-04:00. Expect ~10% request tail latency bump during 02:20-02:50.

alex: +1. Please add rollback steps (how to quickly stop reboot and re-attach nodes) and ping me for rollback.

emily: FYI dedicated customers on reserved capacity won't see service degradation unless their dedicated pool maps to rck-12. Support and sales need a short note about SLA fallback.

marie: Notifying Support + Sales now. Action items: create calendar invite, attach playbook, assign canary owner. Anyone object to Tue 02:00-04:00? If no objections by EOD I'll create the PR and calendar.

kai: No objections from infra. I'll own canary health checks and smoke-test scripts.

pat: I'll be on the call and monitor alerting.

emily: :thumbsup: thanks everyone, will stand by for the calendar and cost summary.
